envelope.text: Differences from upstream, each a compile error or written here:

why:
issue 2024 (2026-10-25) -- LANDED on a HOSTED build: `rclcpp::ParameterEventHandler(node[, qos])` (a `shared_ptr` to a `Node` or a derived type, or `this` from a derived constructor) creates ONE `/parameter_events` subscription (`rcl_interfaces/msg/ParameterEvent`, upstream's `QoS(KeepLast(1))` default) through `Node::create_subscription`, so the entity inventory and the receive-buffer sizing count it like any other subscription (`NROS_PARAM_EVENT_RX_BYTES`, default 4096, is its frame bound). `add_parameter_callback(name, cb, node_name = "")` hands `cb` an `rclcpp::Parameter` for each new or changed value of that parameter of that node (this node when empty, a relative name resolved against this node's namespace, upstream's `resolve_path`), never for a deletion; `add_parameter_event_callback(cb)` hands `cb` every event decoded into the type `cb` takes; both return owning `shared_ptr` handles the handler keeps only weakly, and `remove_*` drop them. THE BOUND, and the platform constraints behind it: a freestanding build has no `std::function`, `std::string` or allocator for the callbacks, handles and decoded values, so constructing one is refused at compile time (`NROS_RCLCPP_REFUSE_PARAMETER_EVENT_HANDLER`); the per-parameter handle is `rclcpp::ParameterCallbackHandle`, upstream's name (issue 2114; until then it was nested as `ParameterEventHandler::ParameterCallbackHandle`, now an alias); there is no runtime typesupport, so an event callback takes the caller's GENERATED `rcl_interfaces::msg::ParameterEvent` (deduced from the callback) and that message must be generated for the image; the static `get_parameter(s)_from_event` helpers are templates over the caller's generated event (issue 2080, their own rows). Held by `parameter_event_handler_runtime.cpp` and `parameter_event_handler_freestanding_probe.cpp` in `just check cpp`.

EARLIER ROW (superseded): gap, absent -- every surface published the topic (issue 2023) and none subscribed to it.
